title: Fragrant Sunshine Rice
subtitle: with Pumpkin, Tomato and Cucumber Yoghurt
description: Moroccan spices give this pilaf-style dish its summery yellow hue. Cook the rice with pumpkin, then serve with a tomato salad and a refreshing combo of yoghurt and grated cucumber.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Peel the pumpkin and cut into 1cm chunks (see Make it faster). Coarsely chop the onion. Halve the tomatoes and quarter any large ones. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Halve 1 cucumber lengthwise, scrape out the seeds with a teaspoon, then thinly slice. Coarsely grate the remaining cucumber, then put in a sieve and squeeze out the excess liquid.

Soften veggies: Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the pumpkin, onion and garlic, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened. Add the Moroccan seasoning and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant.

Cook rice: Add the rice and 2 tsp tomato paste to the pumpkin mixture and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until the grains are well coated. Stir in 300ml boiling water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to low and cook, covered, for 10-12 mins until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stir to loosen the grains, then stand, covered, for 5 mins.
Make tomato salad: Meanwhile, put 1 tbs olive oil and 2 tsp red wine vinegar in a large bowl, season with salt and pepper and whisk to combine. Add the tomatoes and sliced cucumber and toss to coat.

Serve up: Combine the grated cucumber and yoghurt in a bowl and season with salt and pepper. Divide the yellow rice and tomato salad among plates. Dollop with the cucumber yoghurt and drizzle with any remaining salad juices. Enjoy!

Make it faster: There are lots of veggies in this recipe and that means lots of chopping – a great opportunity to get older kids involved with meal prep. Ask them to cut up the tomatoes and cucumbers while you get on with other things.
